mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.5% compresses the risk-free rate, reducing equity discount rates and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 5.0% signals deteriorating labor market conditions, prompting equity investors to anticipate reduced corporate earnings and triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE exceeds 5.0%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) above their 3-month moving averages signals robust consumer demand, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS exceed their 3-month moving averages, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a supply-constrained regime (INDPRO below 6-month moving average), a decline in industrial production signals worsening economic output, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO declines in a supply-constrained regime, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: CPIAUCSL exceeding 3.5% signals persistent inflation, prompting Federal Reserve tightening and reducing equity valuations, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL exceeds 3.5, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Nonfarm payroll growth above 100,000 consistently signals a robust labor market, supporting consumer spending and corporate earnings, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS exceeds 100,000, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts (HOUST) and quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1) above 2.0% signals robust economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST > 0% change and GDPC1 growth rate > 2.0%
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when both HOUST and GDPC1 growth rate exceed thresholds, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production below 100 (index 2017=100) indicates manufacturing contraction, reducing corporate profits and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO is below 100, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
